How often dossier pages spawn inside world containers (police lockers, military storage, hospital cabinets, fire dept lockers). This is separate from zombie drops.
Chance that a firefighter zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Firefighter dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: axe, sledgehammer, crowbar, fireman gear, blow torch.
Chance that a doctor or nurse zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Medical dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: antibiotics, bandages, painkillers, surgical tools.
Chance that a military zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Military dossier requires 3 pages to assemble. Rewards: assault rifles, ammo, camo gear, military backpack.
Chance that a police zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Police dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: pistols, shotguns, ammo, police gear.
Chance that a ranger zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Ranger dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: hunting rifle, shotguns, knife, hatchet, ranger gear.

How close (in tiles) you must be to a stash location to collect the reward (5-50). Default: 15 tiles. Lower = harder to find, higher = easier. Players get color-coded proximity hints as they approach.
Multiplier applied to all stash reward drop chances. Generous doubles the chances, Minimal makes only the most common items drop.

When enabled, stash rewards are loaded from the config file at Zomboid/Lua/DeadMansDossier_Rewards.cfg instead of using the built-in reward tables. The config file is auto-generated with defaults on first server start. Edit it to add, remove, or change reward items and their drop chances. The Reward Rarity multiplier still applies on top.
